short: Three-parameter weighted sieve conditions for RH

lean.name: Formalism.WeightedSieveThreeParameter.WeightedSieveImpliesRHThreeParameter
lean.plain: Three-parameter weighted sieve conditions for RH
lean.note: This proposed weighted-sieve route to RH allows an exceptional set of discriminants and slack in the comparison with Jacobi prime sums. Both allowances must contribute errors of order at most x^(1/2+ε) at every sufficiently large x for each ε > 0, and this proposition is outside the final dependency cone.
